''See also: [[Bastion's Veil Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Bastion]]'s [[Veil]] is a powerful, supernatural wall of mist and fog that serves as the primary defense for the [[Consultants' home]] on the [[Gray Island]]. Created by a renowned [[Soulbound]] named [[Bastion]], the [[Veil]] was established using his former [[Vessel]] and functions as an impenetrable barrier designed to protect, preserve, and conceal. Its primary purpose is to hide the island from the sight of [[Elders]] and suppress their influence, dampening sensory perceptions such as sound, smell, sight, and [[Intent]]. The [[Veil]] is an extremely potent Awakened artifact that can be controlled by the [[Consultants' Guild|Consultant Guild]] Head. While it provides immense security, its use is a measure of last resort; collapsing the mist to cleanse the island of [[Elderspawn]] leaves the territory exposed and without cover for a significant period while the [[Veil]] recovers. Although it is considered one of the greatest protections against [[Elders]], it can be breached by a [[Soulbound]] or pushed aside by the direct will of a [[Great Elder]]. The source of this power is contained within a glass box filled with silvery-blue mist, and the [[Veil]] can also be manifested to shroud ships or specific locations.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Located at the edge of the [[Gray Island]], [[Bastion]]'s [[Veil]] appears as a vast pillar of cloud and an ancient wall of gray mist. This fog acts as if it were held back by a glass barrier, surrounding a secret bay on its fourth side. While [[Bastion's Shadow|Bastion’s Shadow]] can slide through the mist to reach this hidden location, the [[veil]] also serves as an emergency protocol. When released, the mist sweeps all lesser [[Elderspawn]] off the island to cleanse the land, though it eventually vanishes.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Bastion]]'s [[Veil]] is a regenerating phenomenon on [[Gray Island]] consisting of a supernatural blue-gray wall of mist. This silvery-blue fog serves to protect the island from the gazes of [[Elders]] and is produced by the most powerful Awakened artifact held by the [[Consultant]]. Although its purpose was eventually discovered by the enemy, the mist remains a formidable shroud that possesses the ability to collapse inward. During these shifts, figures such as [[Shera]] have been known to emerge from the cloud.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Originally, [[Bastion]]'s [[Veil]] served as a protective mist surrounding the [[Consultant]]’s island, which eventually pulled in the final Guard. This phenomenon possesses a specific [[Intent]] to suppress [[Elders]] and has since thinned until it is nearly non-existent. It is believed that this power may have been responsible for suppressing [[Kelarac]] during the [[Last Battle of the Empire]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Bastion's Veil|Bastion’s Veil]] is a mist that protected the [[Consultant]]’s island.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The last Guard was pulled into [[Bastion's Veil]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Bastion's Veil|Bastion’s Veil]] has thinned almost to nothing.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Bastion's Veil|Bastion’s Veil]] has the [[Intent]] to suppress [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Bastion's Veil|Bastion’s Veil]] is a power that may have suppressed [[Kelarac]] during the [[Last Battle of the Empire]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c26">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 26</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Bastion]]'s [[Veil]] is a silver-blue mist produced by [[Shera's shear]] that can create clouds of fog to muffle voices and hide people from view. This location, which houses the [[Masons]]' headquarters and a [[stone]] pier, serves as the world's greatest protection against [[Elders]] and enforces absolute obedience to the [[Am’haranai|Am'haranai]] leader. Although the [[Guild]] operated for centuries without a [[Soulbound]] tied to this site, [[Shera]] utilizes it as a [[construct]] that she can thicken, dive into, or use to conceal her figure. She can also channel energy into the mist to cause an explosion over the [[Imperial]] Palace or borrow its vision to witness battles. While the [[veil]] provides peace to [[Shera's soul]], it is noted that [[Kelarac]] can provide protections even greater than its power.}}
